title: Player numbers: a read-only summary of the live counters, weekly
problem: The owner asked how to track how many people play. The live game already keeps anonymous daily counters (docs/ANALYTICS.md), but nobody could read them: STATS_KEY was never set.
scope: The owner set STATS_KEY in Cloudflare and GitHub

A GitHub Actions workflow (Player numbers) reads /api/stats with the key and writes a summary of totals only: new players, player-days, opens, games started and finished by type, coming back next day and a week later, where games stop, day by day
Run on demand and every Monday 09:07 Malaysia time (the schedule needs the file on main)
exclusions: Any new counter or data collected (PLAN-018 stays proposed)
Error lines in the summary (the page is public)

acceptance.text: The run reads the live counters and writes the summary
acceptance.evidence: Run 43656784237 (attempt 2): HTTP 200, summary written (32 new players in 30 days, 102 games started).

acceptance.text: The weekly run fires on a Monday
acceptance.evidence: Needs the file on main; first Monday after the merge.

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-15: "how do i track how many players have played this", then "key set" and "yes to weekly report".

added: .github/workflows/stats.yml and scripts/stats-summary.mjs: the Player numbers summary, on demand and weekly
